Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de electrocasnice, electrice și electronice
Responsibilities: 
Designing, developing, and continuously enhancing SAP EWM components ensuring high standards in quality, performance, and long‑term maintainability.
Implementing and extending technical functionalities and system integrations to sustainably strengthen existing solutions.
Analyzing system behavior and optimize performance, applying structured debugging and problem‑solving approaches to ensure stable operations.
Working closely with the team to translate business requirements into robust, process‑oriented solutions that integrate seamlessly into the overall system landscape.
Taking responsibility for technical documentation and support solutions throughout their lifecycle – from design to go‑live and beyond, including stabilization, support, and knowledge transfer.
 Profile: 
Strong expertise in ABAP / ABAP OO and related SAP technologies.
Hands‑on experience with ODATA, IDocs, BAdIs, and interface development.
Proven experience in SAP S/4HANA EWM environments, experience in SAP S/4HANA TM is an advantage.
Solid understanding of warehouse processes and IT systems integration.
Analytical mindset with a hands‑on attitude, eagerness to learn, and a proactive approach.
Familiarity with ServiceNow or comparable ticketing/workflow tools is an advantage.
English knowledge both written and spoken; German language skills are a plus.
